name: BACH_0398
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (82%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review

Invasive stays in the 90% conformal set (16% invasive probability) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 82%, Invasive 16% | Clear lead; invasive not excluded |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 100th pct | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 1, 5, 8) · context · 72% neoplastic nuclei; both above 97% of reference [F7] · Measured
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Fits in situ pattern rather than invasion [F4] · Weak
- **Nuclear size and shape variation** (regions 1, 5, 8) · context · Both at 90th percentile of reference [F9] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Largest positive concept term; spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Case leans on mitoses (Unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- Invasion is limited to a few regions; region 5 (55%) and 1 (38%) show higher invasive risk.
- Nearest reference case, BACH_0134, is Invasive; 1 of 5 neighbors disagrees.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 5, 8:** Highest heatmap contribution; look for stromal invasion versus intact duct borders.
2. **4, 8, 9:** Confirm whether mitotic figures are real; concept spot check was 0/20.
3. **8:** Lymphocyte concept is high, yet HoVer-Net found 0 inflammatory nuclei; verify.
